issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation reverses the logic of the Greek text. The Greek says: 'For I do the good that I want, but I practice the evil that I do not want' (ου γαρ ο θελω ποιω αγαθον αλλ ο ου θελω κακον τουτο πρασσω). The Vietnamese translates it as: 'Because I do NOT do the good I want, but I DO do the evil I do not want.' The negation in the Vietnamese version is placed incorrectly relative to the verbs.
